none: PAS PUBLIC-BF375C: Late Roman copper alloy nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A slightly damaged copper alloy nummus of Constantius II (AD 337 - 361). GLORIA EXERCITVS reverse type depicting two soldiers and two standards. Obverse: Bust right bearing laureate crown and with the legend CONSTANTIUS part of which is missing due to damaged coin rim and legends, IVN and NOB C.Mint of Lyon. Die axis 6 o'clock. RIC VII 254. Struck AD332. Measurements: Long diameter 17.22 mm ,…
